SELECT s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.vat_rate, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dn, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) calc, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'

calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR f.channel_code<>'ST')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT f.sale_date, f.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.vat_rate IN (0.24,0.255)
AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-29' AND DATE '2024-09-04'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH f AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900),
d AS (SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) drl, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores, sum(net_amount) net FROM f GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.*, r.net_sales_before_returns, r.rec, dd.is_trading_day, dd.holiday_name FROM d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT business_date, sum(net_sales_before_returns) net_sales_before_returns, sum(receipts) rec FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900 GROUP BY 1) r ON r.business_date=d.sale_date
LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date=d.sale_date ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'stg_not_in_fact' k, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount-net_amount) v FROM stg_sales_line_load g WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=g.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_total', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_store_key', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_key NOT IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store)
UNION ALL SELECT 'utc_date_differs', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'outside_period_by_ts', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date NOT BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_zero', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND (net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross_net_mismatch', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND abs(gross_amount - round(net_amount*(1+vat_rate),2))>0.011

calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, sum(r.refund_gross-r.refund_net) ret_vat, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.vat_rate, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY f.vat_rate
